## Proposal

What would you like to improve, and what user problem does it solve?

## Scope check

Explain how the proposal remains configuration/diagnostics-only. Requests involving order execution, trading automation, positions, accounts, brokers, or credentials are out of scope.

## Alternatives and safety

Describe alternatives, failure modes, privacy considerations, and how an operator would verify the result.
